plan: This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win), so the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me if I win against a bid above my value; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior history to adjust for, truthful bidding maximizes expected profit. My value is $21, so I will bid $21.

This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid). The dominant strategy in this format is to bid exactly my true value, since bidding higher risks overpaying relative to my value, and bidding lower only reduces my chance of winning without improving the price I'd pay. With no prior history to adjust for opponent behavior, truthful bidding maximizes expected profit.

This is a second-price auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid, not their own bid. In this format, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, as bidding higher risks overpaying beyond my value, and bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Since my value is $13, I should bid $13 to maximize expected profit regardless of other bidders' strategies.
